C08-M10-L08-F1.title: Part A evidence timeline, 2026-11-03 UTC
C08-M10-L08-F1.caption: Saved-record summaries of saved Banyan records. The two threads never share an entity, so the link row is unsupported.
C08-M10-L08-F1.alt: A timeline table with four columns: time, source, entity and claim type. Four rows for WS-104 run from a 06:12 proxy download, through an Office child process near 06:14 and 18 proxy requests between 06:17 and 07:42, to a 48,200,000-byte proxy transfer at 08:12. Two VPN rows for address 203.0.113.66 show eight distinct failed identities and then a success for gopal at 06:46. A final row shows that a link between gopal and WS-104 is unsupported because no shared entity exists.

C08-M10-L08-F2.title: Model outcomes for the four lab cases
C08-M10-L08-F2.caption: Outcome and confidence are assigned separately, and Case 3 has parts with different outcomes.
C08-M10-L08-F2.alt: A table with four columns: case, outcome, confidence and deciding reason. Case 1, the WS-104 thread, is positive for escalation at moderate confidence, conditional on a prevalence check in the saved rows. Case 2, the synthetic WS-411 upload, is benign at high confidence because all six hosts use the destination and a change record explains the increase. Case 3 splits into an authentication pattern that is positive at moderate confidence and a post-login question with no data. Case 4, a link between the threads, is no-data because no join key exists.
